job.title: Product Security Engineer, Offensive Security
job.pay_full: $152,405 a year base salary (excluding equity and bonus); total compensation may also include equity, bonus eligibility and benefits

details.about: This Offensive Security Engineer joins the Application Security team within Coinbase Security. The role brings frontier AI models into how Coinbase finds vulnerabilities at scale, red-teams its AI systems and automates security workflows, connecting traditional penetration testing with AI-augmented offensive security. It owns AI-driven security tooling and works across Vulnerability Management, Offensive Security and Incident Response.
duties: Build, deploy and maintain custom security scanners that use frontier models to find vulnerabilities across Coinbase's products
Lead red teaming of internal AI systems, including jailbreak testing, prompt injection analysis and tool abuse simulation
Build AI-driven automation for vulnerability triage, validation and remediation in the bug bounty and vulnerability response pipelines
Work with engineering teams to prioritise, fix and verify critical vulnerabilities
Mentor junior security engineers on using AI in offensive security work
needs: 3+ years in application security, penetration testing or offensive security, including building custom security tooling
Hands-on experience using LLMs or frontier models to automate security tasks, scale vulnerability research or build scanners
Experience red teaming AI-based systems (prompt injection, jailbreak testing, tool abuse)
Deep understanding of common vulnerability classes (OWASP Top 10, SANS Top 25) and a record of finding and exploiting them in production
Proficiency in at least one language such as Python or Go, writing production-grade security tooling
Responsible use of generative AI with human oversight
details.benefits: Annual base salary $152,405 (excluding equity and bonus). Total compensation may also include equity and bonus eligibility, and benefits including medical, dental, vision and 401(k).
notes: Coinbase is remote-first but not remote-only: expect quarterly in-person working sessions
Candidates may submit at most 3 applications within a 6-month period
